name: HiFi-HARP
description: We introduce HiFi-HARP, a large-scale dataset of 7th-order Higher-Order Ambisonic Room Impulse Responses (HOA-RIRs) consisting of more than 100,000 RIRs generated via a hybrid acoustic simulation in realistic indoor scenes. HiFi-HARP combines geometrically complex, furnished room models from the 3D-FRONT repository with a hybrid simulation pipeline: low-frequency wave-based simulation (finite-difference time-domain) up to 900 Hz is used, while high frequencies above 900 Hz are simulated using a ray-tracing approach. The combined raw RIRs are encoded into the spherical-harmonic domain (AmbiX ACN) for direct auralization. Our dataset extends prior work by providing 7th-order Ambisonic RIRs that combine wave-theoretic accuracy with realistic room content. We detail the generation pipeline (scene and material selection, array design, hybrid simulation, ambisonic encoding) and provide dataset statistics (room volumes, RT60 distributions, absorption properties). evaluation_method: multiple_metrics (impulse-response similarity: MSE/normalized MSE, RT60 error, energy decay curve metrics, and perceptual measures such as PESQ/STOI where applicable)
general_score_metric: MSE / RT60 error (reported alongside perceptual and spatial metrics)
reputation: A specialized audio dataset for high-order ambisonic room impulse responses, mainly used by researchers working on spatial audio and acoustic simulation.
notes: This is primarily a dataset/benchmark for acoustic modeling rather than a standard model leaderboard; evaluation depends on the downstream spatial-audio task.
